THE EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS
Claimant:
Mrs M Nyarko
Respondent:
Oxleas NHS Foundation Trust
Heard at:
London South Employment Tribunal (video hearing)
On:
9 May 2025
Before:
Employment Judge Robinson
Representation
Claimant:
Mr MacDonald (Counsel)
Respondent:
Mr Mitchell (Counsel)
JUDGMENT
The judgment of the Tribunal is that:
1. The Claimant's claim of indirect disability discrimination is dismissed upon
withdrawal by the Claimant.
2. The Claimant's unfair dismissal claim is dismissed on the grounds that it
was not brought within the three month time limit required by s.111(2)(a)
of the Employment Rights Act 1996, and the Tribunal is not satisfied
(under section 111(2)(b)) that it was not reasonably practicable for the
complaint to have brought the claim within that time.
Employment Judge Robinson

Dated: 9 May 2025
